summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue with using exclude on annotated FilteredRelation by copying the _filtered_relations attribute to the new query. The change appears to be minimal and directly related to the problem.

issues.description: The change introduces a new attribute to the Query class (_filtered_relations) which is not documented. This could lead to confusion or misuse if not properly documented.

The comment added in the trim_start method could be slightly improved for clarity. It mentions 'INNER JOINs from filtered relations' which might be clearer if phrased as 'INNER JOINs that are part of filtered relations'.
